printed_to_pdf_page_rule: PDF page floor((printed page + 6) / 2); even printed page left, odd right. Scan widths vary; use the actual PDF page bounds.
row_scope: 75 explicit Delta nonstop rows in selected Chicago/Detroit/Hartford/Florida tables; one later ORD–MSP variant is separately excluded. Connecting/through rows excluded; each independently timed segment retains its own weekdays.

excluded_rows.reason: Starts after the entire import period. The daily footnote-14 variant ending 1 March is imported instead.

operator_identification: All accepted rows use Delta mainline flight numbers below the Delta Connection ranges.
frequency_legend: D encodes blank/daily; X excludes weekdays, 1 Monday through 7 Sunday. Star denotes off-peak fare, not day rollover.

special_cases.Airport suffixes: Chicago is O’Hare/ORD. J=JFK; M=Miami/MIA and F=Fort Lauderdale/FLL. Repeated aggregate tables are not additional flights.
special_cases.March transition: ORD–MSP 391 at 07:00 is daily through 1 March (footnote 14). The second printed row is X7 from 3 March (footnote 8), so it creates no schedule or movement here. Definitions on printed p.49.
special_cases.Weekdays: ORD–BOS 598 excludes Saturday; 576 operates Saturday at a different time. DTW–MIA 501 is weekends, MIA–DTW 554 is Saturday only; no return weekday is inferred.
special_cases.Footnote 4: Ten accepted rows begin 12 February. Effective dates are preserved in row evidence and notes; import dates are inside their valid period.
special_cases.Time zones: DTW–ORD 563 departs 08:20 EST and arrives 08:18 CST, a 58-minute flight. The earlier local arrival is not a previous-day arrival.
special_cases.After midnight: MCO–FLL 261 departs 00:30 and TPA–MIA 141 departs 00:55 on their own local calendar dates. Adjacent late-night inbound segments belong to the preceding departure date when applicable.
special_cases.Exact transcription: TPA–ORD 480 is 11:05–12:31; TPA–DTW 206 is 18:50–21:07. These numbers were resolved in enlarged source rows, before import. MCO–ORD 80 has a stop and is not included.
special_cases.Through rows: Only explicit stops=0 rows are imported. FLL–MSY 91 via Tampa, PBI–MSP 204 via Chicago and comparable through entries create no extra nonstop flights.
special_cases.Aircraft: Generic equipment symbols do not establish an individual aircraft type, registration or same-aircraft continuity.
special_cases.Airport locations: No new airport markers, countries or operators. All existing records remain unchanged.
